text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
(I want to beat her...! No, even more than 
that...!)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
(I want to reach it! Far beyond the image 
I envisioned...!)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ain't nobody gonna beat meeeee!! 
RAAAAAAAAGHHHH!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
If I can just surpass this run...! 
Hyaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Transcend takes the victory!! 
Unbelievable, she's handed a defeat to 
none other than Espoir City!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The astonishing birth of a brand-new star! 
The dirt division is about to get so much 
more exciting from here on out!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... haa... I took it... the 
Champions Cup!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I can't run any more right now... But... 
this pounding in my chest is...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
(I think... I saw it... Just barely... but 
I reached it...)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
(This sensation...! I want to bask in it 
forever...!)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Tch... So annoying... Unforgivable...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
A loss is a loss, though... Guess 
sometimes things just turn out like 
this...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, well, I guess it can't be helped. 
I'll give you credit for today and today 
only.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Come on, say something. Tell me to 
apologize, or get on my knees and grovel.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Ah... No, that kind of thing is...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... But if you're saying you'll do 
whatever I ask...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, Trainy! Lend me the cinema gun, the 
cinema gun!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
On top of your running, let me capture 
every last bit of you on camera, Espo-n.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I rushed onto the track, ran up to her, 
and handed over the Cinema Gun.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Time to start shooting. Hmm, hmm... 
Looking at it like this, it's pretty 
photogenic.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
D-Don't give me that flattery...! Just 
hurry up and take the picture.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well then, don't mind if I do. Let's see, 
running ability is undeniably top-tier, 
and as for other data...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Beep!)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Boasts a passionate fanbase," huh? You 
sure are surrounded by a lot of 
supporters.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"I-It's not like we're homies or anything. 
It's just, like, everyone supports me from 
the bottom of their hearts."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Beep!)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
And her favorite food is "lollipops." 
There are still crumbs around her mouth.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! Having it in my mouth just gets 
me hyped! Like, 'Don't mess with me, 
punk!' ya know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Beep!)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "Actually a really good kid."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Wh-Wh-Wh...?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Don't you start bullshitting me, dammit!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Who're you calling a good girl?! I'm a 
terrifying Umamusume that'd make a crying 
kid shut right up!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
J-Just you remember this! Next time, I'm 
totally gonna make you cryyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, thanks for your business~ And 
with that, the data is all mine.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: It's perfect, right, Trainy?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Securing the target data on top of a 
satisfying victory. Today turned out to be 
a momentous day for Transcend.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And at night. Returning to the Trainer's 
office—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, Trainer-chan. Good job on the 
Classic year. Or 'Curren-chan' if you 
will. Not that it's over yet, though.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I might have caught a glimpse of it right 
at the very, very end. That thrill... I've 
been chasing all this time.
choice_data_list: In the race against Espoir City?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. The girls running at the top really 
are something else. They've got something 
I don't.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Something unique to each of them. Surely 
Furi-o and Falco-chan have it too.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Next year, I want intel on them. No, it's 
not just that I want it, it's more than 
that—"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: I want to try running with both of them!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Today was fun. Really fun. Maybe even the 
best day I've ever had."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: So, Trainy-poo, what should we do next?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I think it over. The GⅠ Tokyo 
Daishoten is also coming up at the end of 
this year, but..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The match against Espoir City was quite 
grueling. Let's take a brief breather 
here—
choice_data_list:
Let's aim for the February Stakes next 
February.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
The February Stakes... Just like today, 
it's a Central dirt GI.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, someone is bound to show up there. 
Either Furioso, or maybe Falco-chan, who's 
been traveling around the regional 
circuits lately, dropping by for a visit.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Aah... this is so fun, Trainie. It feels 
like every day just keeps getting more and 
more fulfilling.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Let's experience even more thrills next 
year. Together, just the two of us.
